correctness.rationale: Explicit source-sum evaluation for both residues yields reciprocal sextic. The s+1/s transformed cubic has a factored strictly negative discriminant and unique real root less than -2; every reciprocal pair has one simple interior root. Uniform polynomial rescaling about the double limiting root u=-1 gives v=±i√2, and inversion gives the exact radial coefficient. Standalone exact verifier passed 610 auxiliary tests; finite tests not substituted for proof.
